title: UA Vehicle Registry — Normalized Record
description: Schema for a single record in the normalized UA vehicle registry snapshots (v3.0). All snapshots 2013–2026 are built the same way: one revision of the MIA open registry per period (docs/SOURCES.md), one row per distinct source row, identified by `record_id`. A column for which the source has no value in a given period is omitted from that file rather than written as all-null: registration plates and VIN are not published for 2013–2020, engine power is published by the source from 2026-04-30, plates and owner KOATUU are not published by the source from 2026-04-30. Read columns by name and treat every column as optional.

record_id.description: MD5 of the source fields of the row (operation name excluded: the source spells one operation in several ways). Unique across the dataset.

person_type.description: Type of owner. P = natural person (фізична особа), J = legal entity (юридична особа).

reg_addr_koatuu.description: KOATUU code of the owner's registered address, as a string to keep leading zeros. Not in the source from 2026-04-30.

oper_code.description: Numeric code of the registration operation. Identifies the operation; use it rather than oper_name for grouping.

oper_name.description: Operation name as in the source, with Latin I inside Cyrillic words replaced by Cyrillic І. The source uses more than one wording for some codes.

d_reg.description: Date of the registration operation. Parquet type DATE; CSV text YYYY-MM-DD.

dep_code.description: Service center code, as a string. From 2026-04-30 recovered from the service center name; null where no match exists.

brand.description: Brand in Latin script. Brands present in the reference catalogue get the catalogue spelling (Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz) regardless of the model; others keep the source spelling.

model.description: Model in Latin script, mapped to a catalogue model family where one exists (MEGANE SCENIC → Scenic); otherwise the source model.

vin.description: Normalized VIN: upper case, separators removed, Cyrillic look-alike letters replaced by Latin (А→A, В→B, З→3 …). Other Cyrillic letters are kept. Matches the 17-character VIN pattern only where is_valid_vin is true. The source has VINs from 2021.

make_year.description: Year of manufacture as in the source; NULL when later than the registration year + 1 (impossible value). Four 2013 typos corrected (2088→2008, 2033→2003 twice, 2036→2006). 1900 is a source placeholder for an unknown year.

color.description: Body color. The 2025+ source spelling 'ПОМАРАНЧЕВИЙ (ОРАНЖЕВИЙ)' is published as 'Оранжевий', as in 2013–2024.

body.description: Body type group (e.g. Седан, Хетчбек, Сідловий Тягач); null where the source value is empty or unknown to the mapping.

fuel.description: Primary fuel (Бензин, Дизель, Газ, Електро, Водень). For hybrids the combustion fuel; the electric part is in secondary_fuel.

capacity.description: Engine displacement in cm³ exactly as in the source, including electric vehicles (where the source often has an empty value or battery capacity).

power_kwt.description: Engine power in kW with the source precision (154.6). Published by the source from 2026-04-30; carried to other registrations of the same VIN found in the source (2021 onward).

own_weight.description: Curb weight in kg as in the source.

total_weight.description: Gross weight in kg as in the source.

payload.description: total_weight − own_weight; null where own_weight exceeds total_weight (a source error).

n_reg_new.description: Registration plate, 2021-01-01 … 2026-04-29 only. Not published for 2013–2020; not in the source from 2026-04-30.

secondary_fuel.description: Secondary fuel (Газ for LPG/CNG, Електро for hybrids).

n_reg_latin.description: n_reg_new transliterated to Latin. Same periods as n_reg_new.

is_valid_plate.description: Whether the plate matches one of the standard civilian formats: AA0000AA (2004+), 00000AA (1995–2004), online-registration codes. Other formats (e.g. 16ВР3029, diplomatic) give false. Same periods as n_reg_new.

raw_vin.description: VIN exactly as in the source. From 2021.

is_valid_vin.description: True when vin is 17 characters from the VIN alphabet (no I, O, Q) and does not start with 0. Format check only: the check digit is not verified, because most non-North-American VINs do not use one. From 2021.
